units.source_text: 鞠子依旧裸露着乳房，哼着歌曲。

en.t: Mariko still had her breasts exposed and was humming a song.

units.source_text: 这歌声中夹杂着苍蝇的振翅声。

en.t: Mixed in with her singing was the sound of flies beating their wings.

units.source_text: 苍蝇在她的四周飞来飞去，偶尔落在她的乳房上，她只说声："真痒痒啊！"却无意去驱赶它。

en.t: The flies buzzed back and forth around her, sometimes settling on her breasts; she merely said, "How itchy!" and made no move to drive them away.

units.source_text: 苍蝇落在乳房上的时候，像是粘在上面似的。

en.t: When a fly landed on her breast, it seemed almost to stick there.

units.source_text: 令人吃惊的是，对鞠子来说，这并不完全是一种爱抚。

en.t: What was startling was that, for Mariko, this was not entirely a caress.
